query: what does Effective technological measure mean?
response: Effective technological measures are techniques or tools used during normal operation with the primary function of protecting copyright and related rights from unauthorized acts made without the permission of the copyright owner or relevant right holder, as defined in Article 10c. of Vietnamese Law No. 07/2022/QH15 of June 16, 2022.
